Use case: ui-mockup / detailed game art-direction specification board, NOT a screenshot and NOT a playable app. Create original refined raster artwork inherited from reference Image 1, the approved GeoGuard master r02. Cream #FFF9EF, warm dark brown #4B281C typography and soft rounded outlines, restrained sage #B6D4AE, coral #F4ADA0, honey #F8DDAA, mint resource DIAMONDS, and pale blue #C7E4F4 for reward accents. Quiet elegant sticker shapes, flat soft fills, tiny restrained shadows, crisp Chinese text. NO white text on pale backgrounds. No futuristic panels, neon, metallic realism, board game frame, invented map obstacles. Do not copy a whole reference sheet or its technical guide labels into player UI. Each panel/cell has generous padding and large readable type. Entire board rendered at high resolution, landscape 3:2, roughly 2400x1600 or higher if available. Fine mockup drawing, no code/HTML/SVG.
All numeric values are dynamic EXAMPLES, logical sizes are design targets, not measured device verification. Footer exactly "原画设计 · 数值为动态示例 · 非实机验证". All tiny explanatory rules outside the mockups are DESIGN ANNOTATIONS, not extra player controls. No debug menus, no paid upgrade, no audio control, no permanent joystick, no shop, no selling towers, no score or victory screen.

Image 2 is authoritative BASIC NEUTRAL body, image 3 CANNON upper / SNIPER lower NEUTRAL body, image 4 BURST NEUTRAL, image 5 faceless one-leaf PLAYER. Reuse exact approved bodies for miniature cards: BASIC TWO top buds, ONE rear lobe, TWO feet, ONE near eye, cheek curve and ONE short tube; CANNON two upper buds/two feet/one eye/one large barrel, NO smile or mouth; SNIPER pear long neck/two feet/two top eyes/one long thin beak/one belly patch; BURST four equal holes in regular 2x2 plane; PLAYER one honey drop and ONE sage leaf, NO face/limbs/tube. No projectiles baked into icons. No new bodies.
Title "UI01 / HUD · BUILD · HINTS". Make two large labeled viewport mockups: desktop on left ~65% and phone portrait on right ~27%. Proper phone frame aspect 390:844, NOT desktop shrink. The desktop target label "A · 桌面 1440×900"; phone label "B · 手机 390×844". Reserve room underneath for 3 short annotation cells C/D/E.
A desktop: follow master horizontal top arrangement HP left, wave/time center, money and Pause right. Exact "HP 100/100", a coral HP bar, "WAVE 23", clock "04:12", mint diamond "240", pale sage button "暂停". Below centered single Boss panel TEXT ONLY, no new boss drawing: title "蜂巢建筑师", line "孵潮 · P2/3", thin coral HP bar, action "恢复 · 输出窗口", counterplay exact "优先拆掉孵化巢，阻止生产并取消巢的爆发攻击。" Dark brown all. Enough vertical room with counterplay wrapping if needed. Use a SMALL separate status banner below boss with "Boss 出现 · 蜂巢建筑师"; never overlap Boss.
Keep broad quiet open central combat space; only a small exact PLAYER and one small BASIC tower to imply scale, no enemies/hazards on this UI board. Near bottom a pale honey closed-hint strip exact "电脑：WASD/方向键移动，拖拽塔卡建造" and button "我知道了". Bottom build bar rounded cream, four representative existing unlocked cards in correct order BASIC, CANNON, SNIPER, BURST: names "速射塔","榴弹炮","穿透塔","散射塔", resource prices 15/40/80/66, each "Lv.1/4", tags "单体 · 0.3秒","范围 · 1.5秒","穿透 · 2秒","散射 · 0.95秒". Include exact body thumbnails from refs, fixed source organs. Example money=240 so none insufficient here.
B phone: first row compact but readable HP/money/Pause, second row "WAVE 23 · 04:12". Boss directly below in full-width cream panel: same long counterplay wrapped into TWO or THREE readable lines; same title, phase P2/3, HP bar and action. Preserve all data, no ellipsis. Separate short status banner below; broad central battle space. Mobile hint in two short lines "手机：长按空白处移动角色" / "拖拽塔卡建造", with right/bottom large close pill "知道了 (30s)". Bottom cards each minimum readable logical width about 124px; show TWO full cards BASIC and CANNON and part of SNIPER as scroll affordance, side fade. Each visible full card MUST include name, icon, mint price, Lv.1/4 and its effect/interval. No arrow buttons or lock cards. Allow horizontal scroll, not 9 tiny icons. Leave bottom safety padding. In battle empty space draw a very faint temporary touch start ring with fingertip and label "按下时出现"; it is a conditional diagram and must not look like a permanent joystick.
C annotation: "更多已解锁塔：横向滚动" + tiny gesture horizontal arrows over bar, no player buttons. D annotation: "横移滚栏 / 长按180ms或上拖建造", clearly drawing two different fingertip gestures. E annotation: "松开触点消失 / 提示可关闭", no always-present joystick. Labels annotate conditional state only. Footer design limits. Keep hint text and card prices entirely unclipped. All generated text accurate with no extra control.

A: exact title "几何防线"; small standalone sage leaf emblem allowed as decorative branding, NOT character. Description "移动角色自动射击。收集水晶，在地图上布置你的防御塔阵地。" Pale sage CTA dark brown "开始游戏". Only ONE CTA, no development entry.

C: exact "游戏已暂停"; "准备好后继续，按 Esc 也可恢复。"; pale sage dark brown CTA "继续游戏". One button only.
D: heading "Boss 已击破", subheading "选择一项强化，下一波即将开始。", small "BOSS CLEAR". Three large whole clickable cards labeled 01/02/03. 01 pale blue / unlock, badge "新防御塔", title "解锁 霜冻塔", subtitle "加入建造栏，并获得 55 资金试建", detail "造成减速，帮助阵线控场。" and "造价55 / 伤害7 / 射程190 / 间隔0.85秒 / 减速", bottom CTA-style LABEL "解锁蓝图". 02 sage / upgrade, badge "属性提升", title "升级 速射塔 蓝图", subtitle "等级 1 → 等级 2", exact detail "仅强化后续建造，已有塔保持原等级。", "获得5资金补贴 · 造价15→20", "伤害7 / 射程194 / 间隔0.28秒", bottom CTA-style LABEL "应用升级". 03 honey / support, badge and title "物资补给", subtitle "立即获取 120 资金", detail "获得一笔额外的资金，而不是选择防御塔。", bottom CTA-style LABEL "获取物资". Small approved-style book/snowflake for unlock, book/up arrow for upgrade, mint diamond for support; these are reward UI symbols, not redesigned tower bodies. The card itself selects, no confirmation dialog.
E phone target "手机390×844 · 纵向滚动": three stacked cream cards with same unlock/upgrade/support titles, value details and labels; preserve the upgrade future-only sentence and full amount text, no microscopic triplet columns. A subtle bottom scroll cut/fade is permitted only while indicating all3 choices accessible; no added player scroll buttons.
F ALTERNATIVE STATE: one pale coral card titled "紧急修复", subtitle "在下一波前恢复 42 点生命值", detail "立即恢复生命值，稳定防线。", heart symbol, label "立即修复". Next to it show clear explanatory text OUTSIDE the popup: "替换其中一卡 · 总数仍为三项" and three tiny SLOT BLOCKS named "解锁 / 修复 / 升级". Do not draw repair attached as fourth simultaneous option. Repair applies PLAYER HP, never tower HP.
G rule: left block "已有塔 / 保持原等级", right block "后续建造 / 应用新蓝图". Arrow from upgrade card toward FUTURE block only, NOT from old tower to new tower. Caption "选择后进入下一波" and "蓝图只影响后续建造". Add compact design annotation "费用、等级、补贴、修复量来自实际choice". No payment UI and no upgrade-on-field button. Every CTA dark brown on light background. Footer exactly states design/sample/untested.

A upper-left: THREE complete large BASIC tower cards side by side, same exact neutral body as Image2: TWO buds, one rear lobe, two feet, one eye/cheek curve, one short single tube. Cards title "速射塔". NORMAL card mint price15, "Lv.1/4", "单体 · 0.3秒". UPGRADED BLUEPRINT card external label "UP +1", mint price20, "Lv.2/4", "单体 · 0.28秒". Green circle with check marker, coral circle with cross marker, honey failure text. Markers are noninteractive visual states. Under diagrams a release-to-bar sketch with "回栏取消 · 不扣费", no trash bin or sell control; annotation "拖到场地里建造". Explain "暂停/奖励中清除拖放" in small readable outside text. Resource spent only on successful placement.
